content.text: `bat cache --clear` now honors `--target`: `clear_assets` takes the cache directory as a parameter, `run_cache_subcommand` resolves `--target` (falling back to `PROJECT_DIRS.cache_dir()`), and `clear_asset` removes a full path instead of re-deriving the default dir; the `--target` arg in `src/bin/bat/clap_app.rs:573` no longer `requires("build")` so it can be used with `--clear`. Verified with `cargo build` plus `cargo test --test integration_tests cache_clear -- --ignored`, which passes without touching the test file.
